title: Cartan Subalgebras of Dimension Drop Interval Algebras and Their Inductive Limits
summary: We describe the conjugacy of non-degenerate Cartan subalgebras of the dimension drop interval algebras $M_m(\widetilde{\mathbb I}_p)$ in terms of double cosets of permutation groups, and describe their spectra by finite bi-partite multigraphs. All Cartan subalgebras are non-degenerate precisely when the two parameters are coprime. We also give splitting interval examples with prescribed finite numbers of Cartan conjugacy classes. Passing to inductive limits, we construct a unital simple AD algebra $\mathcal{A}$ of real rank zero and stable rank one, with $K_0(\mathcal{A})\cong\mathbb Z[1/3]$…
